summary: SEALSQ Corp filed a Form 6-K on April 21, 2026, covering a press release and notice for its 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for May 7, 2026. The agenda includes re-election of seven board members (five non-executive) for one-year terms. No special situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic changes are present; this is a routine foreign private issuer report on an annual meeting.
